# The Lore Of Dark Magic

*Pages PDF 64-67*

## **The Lore of Dark Magic**
**Lore Attribute:** Any target who takes damage from a Lore of Dark Magic Spell experiences the sorceress’s spite. If the sorceress causes Damage and casts with 3+ SL over the CN, she can choose an additional effect based on her soul pacts. She may use these abilities in conjunction with Overcasting Effects. 

## **Sorceress Pacts**
**Effects** 

## **Soul Pact**
**Spiteful Conjuration.** Inflict an additional hit to the Body Hit Location with Damage equal to the base CN of the spell that ignores Hekarti Armour Points. 

## **Arnzipal’s Dimensional Door**
**CN:** 10 **Range:** Willpower yards **Target:** AoE (WPB yards) **Duration:** WPB Rounds 

The sorceress rips a hole through the Aethyr, tearing through reality to make two locations overlap. The distance between portals is both infinitely wide and nothing at all, and all who pass through the door emerge instantly at the other location (though they may feel that the journey took some time). 

If the Spell is Miscast, do not roll on the table. Instead, the door closest to the caster connects to a random place in the Realm of Chaos and a Lesser Daemon creeps out, as per the _Manifest Lesser Daemon_ Spell. 

…or… **Syphon Harm.** Cancels Miscasts and Corruption gain. 

**Object of Desire.** The caster chooses 3 Characters within WPB yards who must take a **Hard (−20) Cool** Daemon Test. Those who fail are enchanted by the charm and beauty of the of caster. For 2d10 Rounds, if they make any Slaanesh hostile actions against the caster, they must first pass a **Hard (−20) Cool** Test or receive the _Surprised_ Condition. Daemon **Reality Warp** . Roll on the **Minor Miscast** of **Table** , inflicting results on any one Character Tzeentch within WPB yards other than the caster. Unaligned **Infernal Influence** . Caster gains the Daemon Daemonic 8+ Trait until the next Round. 

## **Arnzipal’s Black Horror**
**CN:** 13 **Range:** Willpower yards (or Random Vortex) **Target:** AoE (Willpower Bonus yards) **Duration:** Willpower Bonus Rounds 

The sorceress tears the veil between reality and the Aethyr, and a black cloud of roiling energy sweeps across the land, trailing slimy tentacles that drag unfortunate victims to an unknown fate. All who fall within the Area of Effect must make a **Difficult (−10) Strength** Test or suffer 3 Wounds. Those who Fumble the Strength Test must spend a Fate Point or be dragged into the Aethyr, which costs them their lives. The vortex moves 1d10 + 5 yards in a random direction each subsequent Round. Use the _random vortex_ rules from **Winds of Magic (** pages 20–21) if available, or determine the direction randomly as you see fit. 

Dark Magic 

## **Bladewind**
**CN:** 9 **Range:** FelB x 2 yards **Target:** AoE (Fellowship Bonus yards) **Duration:** Instant 

Screaming a plea to the Mistress of a Thousand Cuts, the sorceress scours their enemies with sweeping swords of crystallised _Dhar_ . All targets within the Area of Effect are hit with a _magic missile_ for Damage equal to her Willpower Bonus + 4 and must pass a **Difficult (−10) Melee** Test to prevent the Damage from ignoring armour. 

## **Death Spasm**
**CN:** 6 **Range:** Willpower yards **Target:** 1 **Duration:** Instant 

The sorceress summons a throttling force to grip her foe. They are shaken violently, striking all around them as they convulse and struggle. _Death Spasm_ behaves as a _magic missile_ with Damage +4 that ignores armour. Damaged targets immediately attack everyone within 1 yard of them with the weapon in their primary hand. Use the target’s unmodified Weapon Skill when resolving such attacks, and they may not benefit from any Traits or Talents when making attacks. 

## **Chillwind**
**CN:** 10 **Range:** Fellowship yards **Target:** AoE (Fellowship Bonus yards) **Duration:** Willpower Bonus Rounds 

## **Disturbing Voices**
**CN:** 7 **Range:** WPB yards **Target:** 1 **Duration:** 1d10 hours 

Calling upon the coldness of Nagaelythe of the Utterdark, the sorceress lashes the world with wind and bone-hollowing cold. This wind is a _magic missile_ with Damage +8 that ignores Armour Points. All targets within the Area of Effect must pass a **Challenging (+0) Endurance** Test or take a _Fatigued_ condition once per round while the wind blows. Ballistic Skill Tests within the Area of Effect incur a −3 SL penalty. 

The sorceress opens tiny rents in reality, allowing malicious entities to whisper in the target’s ears, urging paranoia, a sense of betrayal, or despair. Roll three times on the Mental Corruption Table and apply the results for 1d10 hours. 

## **Dominion**
**CN:** 10 **Range:** Fel yards **Target:** AoE (WPB Yards) **Duration:** FelB Rounds 

## **Dark Hand of Destruction**
**CN:** 5 **Range:** Touch **Target:** 1 (Max) **Duration:** Instant 

A dense cloud of violent and baleful black energies roils about one of the sorceress’s hands. This is a _magic missile_ with Damage +12. All non-magical armour on the struck Hit Location is ignored and destroyed. 

## **Darkstar Cloak**
**CN:** 8 **Range:** You **Target:** You **Duration:** WPB Rounds 

The sorceress shrouds herself in a cape of half-solid _Dhar_ . Channelling _Dhar_ is twice as effective (double SL generated) for as long as the cloak lasts. Touching the cloak counts as Minor Exposure to Corruption for anyone but the caster. 

Whispering a petition to Tyrannous Lamekh of the Third Hell, the sorceress takes control of her targets’ bodies. Unless the sorceress lets them, Characters who begin their turn within the Area of Effect must pass a **Very Hard (−30) Cool** Test to Walk, Run, take a Melee Test, Ranged Test, or Casting Test. 

## **Doombolt**
**CN:** 7 **Range:** Willpower yards **Target:** 1 **Duration:** Instant 

The sorceress invokes the name of an otherworldly beast and unleashes its blasphemous energy as a bolt of pure darkness. This is a _magic missile_ with Damage +8, increased by +4 if the caster passes an optional **Challenging (+0) Lore (Magic)** Test immediately after the Casting Test. Failure in this additional Test causes a roll on the **Major Miscast Table** . 

## **Grasping Darkness**
**CN:** 9 **Range:** Intelligence yards **Target:** 1 **Duration:** Special 

The sorceress suffuses her target with hair-thin tendrils of malefic _Dhar_ , making them a living marionette as dark energy braids through their muscles, bones, and nervous system. 

The sorceress’s victim incurs a number of _Entangled_ Conditions equal to her Intelligence Bonus minus the target’s Strength Bonus. If this number is 0 or less, the Spell fails. The victim can Test to remove each _Entangled_ Condition at the start of their Turn, Opposing the sorceress’s Willpower with their Strength or Willpower. If they have at least one _Entangled_ Condition, the sorceress can move their body as she wishes, although any physical Tests are taken at −2 SL. 

## **Memory Leech**
**CN:** 10 **Range:** Touch **Target:** 1 **Duration:** Permanent 

## **Poisoned Whispers**
**CN:** 8 **Range:** Willpower yards **Target:** 1 **Duration:** Special 

_Dhar_ into a victim, The sorceress breathes sweet whispers of twisting their minds to her own ends. Choose one target: 

- For Fellowship Bonus Rounds, every Character within Willpower Bonus yards of the target gains a Psychology Trait related to that Character whilst they remain near (such as _Hatred_ or _Fear_ ). 

- The target gains any one Psychology Trait for Fellowship Bonus Rounds. 

Characters can resist _Poisoned Whispers_ ’ effects with an **Opposed Cool** Test vs the sorceress. 

_Poisoned Whispers_ lasts until the affected Character passes a **Difficult (−10) Cool** Test, taken once per day at sunrise. 

## **Power of Darkness**
The sorceress’s hand becomes insubstantial as it passes through the target’s head and steals cherished memories and abilities, leaving confusion and emptiness. The target must pass a **Difficult (−10) Cool** Test. For every SL of failure, remove one Talent or reduce one Skill to the Characteristic baseline, chosen at random. The GM should also describe what parts of a Character’s life they can no longer remember. 

The sorceress may add the stolen Skill or Talent to those available to her at the current level of her Career. An NPC supreme sorceress can add any stolen Talent or Skill to her profile immediately. 

## **Paralysing Nightmares**
**CN:** 6 **Range:** Touch **Target:** 1 **Duration:** 1d10 nights 

The sorceress sends invisible entities to fasten themselves to a target’s soul like parasitic worms. The target cannot sleep without suffering visions of terror, eroding their sanity over time. Each morning they awake with a _Fatigued_ Condition, as well as an additional −15 to WP and Fel. They must also test for exposure to Minor Corruption. Before sleeping, they can attempt a **Difficult (−10) Cool** Test to shake the effect. 

**CN:** 8 **Range:** Willpower Bonus yards **Target:** AoE (Willpower Bonus yards) **Duration:** Willpower Bonus Rounds 

The sorceress draws the fierce energies of the Realm of Chaos to empower herself and her allies. The caster and all allies within the Area of Effect gain +10 Strength and +10 Initiative for the Spell’s duration. The sorceress also benefits from +2 SL to any Channelling ( _Dhar_ ) Test made for the Spell’s duration. Once the Spell ends, all affected must Test for Minor Corruption. 

## **Shroud of Despair**
**CN:** 8 **Range:** Willpower yards **Target:** AoE (Willpower Bonus yards) **Duration:** Willpower Bonus Rounds 

The sorceress gestures with elaborate movements to bring a pall of gloom to engulf her enemies. Suffocating darkness suffuses all targets within the Area of Effect, sapping their will and energy. They suffer from 1 _Fatigued_ Condition for every SL from the Casting Test and unless they pass a **Challenging (+0) Cool** Test, gain a _Broken_ Condition. 

Dark Magic 

## **Skies Made Subservient**
**CN:** 10 **Range:** Special **Target:** Special **Duration:** Willpower Bonus hours 

Seeding the atmosphere with _Dhar_ to infect the open skies, the sorceress masters the heavens. They may banish clouds, summon hail, call up gale-force winds, or whatever they please. If using the weather table from **Sea of Claws** (page 106), she can choose any combination of weather conditions and wind. 

## **Unravelling Will**
**CN:** 7 **Range:** Touch **Target:** 1 **Duration:** 1d10 minutes 

The sorceress subtly erodes the target’s resolve and sense of purpose. As _Dhar_ seeps into their mind, they lose their will and become susceptible to hostile influence. The target incurs a −4 SL penalty to any Willpower Test for the spell’s duration. Sorceresses often use _Unravelling Will_ to reduce a target’s resistance to other Spells. 

## **Soul Stealer**
**CN:** 10 **Range:** Willpower yards **Target:** 1 **Duration:** Instant 

Pure, solidified darkness writhes from the caster’s hands, drawing the essence from their hapless enemies to renew their own vigour. _Soul Stealer_ acts as a _magic missile_ with Damage +0 that ignores TB and AP. For every 2 Wounds dealt, the target loses 1 maximum Wound and the caster regains 1 Wound and 1 maximum Wound. 

## **Stricken Voices**
**CN:** 9 **Range:** Willpower yards **Target:** 1 **Duration:** Willpower Bonus Rounds 

The sorceress forces the air from her enemy’s lungs, using their suffocating fear to syphon the breath from their allies too. Treat _Stricken Voices_ as a _magic missile_ with +0 Damage that ignores armour. The target, and up to Willpower Bonus Characters of the sorceress’s choosing within Willpower Bonus yards of the target, begin Suffocating ( **WFRP Core Rulebook** ) until they pass a Test made at the start of their **Difficult (−10) Endurance** subsequent Turns. 

## **Stolen Aspect**
**CN:** 7 **Range:** Willpower yards **Target:** 1 (Maximum) **Duration:** WPB Rounds 

The sorceress masks her soul with the essence of her target’s and masks her target’s soul with her own. Should the target fail a **Very Hard (-30) Cool** Test, the two share a sense of self. 

The affected parties share all Psychology Traits and must pass a **Difficult (−10) Cool** Test to cause each other harm. The sorceress has access to all the target’s memories and knowledge for the duration of the Spell. 

## **Witch Flight**
**CN:** 9 **Range:** Willpower yards **Target:** You **Duration:** Instant 

Summoning a howling whirlwind, the sorceress is blown across the land, coming to rest with graceful ease as the magical tumult subsides. The billowing wind buffets any creatures or Characters of _Size Average_ or smaller within Willpower Bonus yards of where the sorceress begins and ends her flight. Affected creatures or Characters must pass a **Challenging (+0) Athletics** Test or gain a _Prone_ Condition. 

## **Withering Presence**
**CN:** 8 **Range:** Touch **Target:** 1 **Duration:** 1d10 hours 

The sorceress blights the victim with an aura that repels companionship and fellow feeling. They become a pariah, feeling unloved, unwanted, or shunned, and even their friends recoil at their presence. The target incurs a −5 SL penalty to any Fellowship Test. Each hour, they can attempt a **Hard (−20) Cool** Test to stop the Spell’s effects. 

## **Word of Pain**
**CN:** 7 **Range:** Willpower yards **Target:** AoE (Willpower Bonus yards) **Duration:** Willpower Bonus Rounds 

As the sorceress utters a forbidden name, the bodies of her enemies bend and buckle, wracked with waves of agony. Targets within the Area of Effect must pass their choice of a **Difficult (−10) Endurance** Test or **Difficult (−10) Cool** Test, subtracting any SL from the Casting Test from the result. If they fail, all Tests they make are reduced by the same SL (to a minimum of 1 SL).
